title: 第五章 人王经第六章 初入灵泽
content_zh:
堂内，人影渐稀。
估计用不了多久，他楚天舒与楚玥的半年之约，便会传遍整个楚家。
“天舒……你……”楚鸿欲言又止，“唉——”
“你这孩子，也太莽撞了！半年……半年啊！你拿什么对战楚玥呀？”杜娴火上眉梢，一把揪住了楚天舒的耳朵。
“哎呦！娘！你干什么啊？”楚天舒连忙求饶道，“我真有把握能在半年之后……嘶啊！轻点……娘轻点呀！”
“简直胡闹！半年之约？你还嫌不够丢脸吗？”杜娴越想越气，“别以为有些小聪明就可以为所欲为，这沧澜大陆上实力为尊！你再聪明又有什么用？能修炼到脉络吗？”
“就算打不过，丢的也是我的脸，不关你和爹什么事。”楚天舒苦叫道，“娘，疼啊！松手……”
“唉——”杜娴似乎明白了儿子的“计谋”，半年之后输了就可以把所有的耻辱全都揽到自己身上。
“事已至此，”楚鸿道，“天舒，你受得了半年后那份耻辱吗？要不……让天清代你上场？”
楚天清脸都白了：“别呀，爹你知道的，就半年时间，我拼死拼活也就灵泽四级罢了，怎么可能抗衡楚玥啊？即使她自压修为只用一脉实力，我也不是对手啊。”
“那可未必！”楚鸿郑重道，“我云脉有个隐秘传承或许能让你半年之后达到抗衡她的实力。”
闻言，杜娴放下了手，楚天舒揉捏着充血的红耳朵，别是一番滋味在心头。
“隐秘传承？”楚天清疑惑道。
“没错，那份传承非上等资质者无法获取，是我们楚家的一位先祖所传之法。为父我当初也是凭借此法，才能快速突破脉络。”楚鸿回忆道。
“那太好了，有了此法我定能击败那楚玥！”楚天清满脸期待道。
“哪那么容易，我好歹也教导了楚玥四年，她的天赋我都看在眼里，当真是天赋卓绝又努力刻苦，练手皮被剑柄磨得血淋淋的都还在坚持。”杜娴没等楚天清高兴太久，便泼下了一盆冷水。
“的确，那孩子确实卓绝，称得上是楚家年轻一代的魁首，只可惜不知怎的就投了青脉？我们俩待她如此好，不应该会这样呀？”楚鸿喃喃自语，随后目光又锁定了楚天舒，“难道是你这小子对楚玥做了什么过分的事？令她怀恨在心？”
“没有！”楚天舒后退数步，“那你们先忙传承吧，我就先去修炼了。”
一转眼，楚天舒就溜走了。夫妇二人对视一眼，皆从对方的眼底看出了无奈。
出了议事堂，楚天舒没有先回家，而是前往集市购置了一大批药材兽血。

夜晚才回到自己的寝室内。
楚天舒自储物袋取出购买的大量灵植：火罗果、蓝银草、藤根、乌仙芝……前前后后共十几袋草药。
“这具身体还算好，气血浓郁，肉体素质远超同龄人，这样一来就先走炼体这条路吧。”楚天舒自语道，“炼体……我能选择的不多。”
楚天舒在脑海中回想着前世得到的功法：
“斗战圣转诀，只攻不防、天下无双，是近古以来最为强大的攻击功法，前世我练至大成，连跨七个小境界击杀敌手。但……此功法走的是极端路线，根本就没有恢复防御的手段，不利于久战，得再找找其它的功法。”
楚天舒一番思考过后便果断放弃了“斗战圣转诀”转而考虑前世主修的自创功法：“无极真魔功！我前世吸取百家所长，以魔身为根基自创的功法，几乎没有太大的短板和缺陷，就连圣殿的无上秘法太玄圣灵术都略逊一筹。可肉体部分的修炼法太少了，况且……魔道在今世可是个禁忌！”
近古时期，魔道在他的率领下成了人族最为强大的一派，可如今被打压得成啥了呀？就楚天舒所了解的信息来说，魔道在今天这个时代，都快被正道杀灭绝了，衰败得不成样子！哪还有近古时的半分威风？
楚天舒猜测，魔道被打压大概率是和他有关的。自己坐化后，魔道群龙无首，成了一盘散沙。分裂的分裂，内斗的内斗，正道三教肯定趁此机会重回人族主派，当真是盛衰有数。
这下楚天舒可犯难了，因为剩下的功法没有达到令他满意的程度。
“等等！我想起来了，好像还有一部功法能令我满意。”楚天舒脑海中突然闪过一抹灵光，“人王经！中古时期炼体无上功法，源自开创人族炼体法的人王一脉，号称古往今来第一炼体秘术！前世我偶然间得到末代人王的传承，虽炼了一些时日，但与我的魔功相冲，不得不放弃，重来一世，正好可以修炼！”
《人王经》也和《无极真魔功》一样，几乎无任何短板，若不是近古时期“灵力大爆发”，灵气在天地间浓郁得不像话，炼体法不适应这天地环境，被大部分修士所抛弃，人王一脉日渐衰落，几乎快要绝后了，末代人王才不得不将此法传给“魔主”等一众天资卓绝者。否则楚天舒不可能在后世修炼这部无上功法。
“就人王经了！”楚天舒深吸一口气下定决心：“青儿，打水来，然后将这些药材各取三小块放入盆中。”
“来了。”
青儿踏着灵巧的步子，走入室内，目光中带着强烈的好奇：“少爷，这些是什么东西啊？”
“修炼用的药材。”楚天舒道。
“药材？哪有人在修炼浴盆里泡着修炼的？”青儿道，“少爷，是不是听信某些奇奇怪怪的偏方秘诀了。”
“好了，赶紧给我拿水来。”楚天舒不耐烦道。
“独灵脉……独灵脉……少爷这么聪明，怎么可能是独灵脉呢？”青儿惋惜道，“真是独灵脉，那不成废物了吗？”
由于穿越的缘故，楚天舒身体里是来自二十一世纪的灵魂，他对于这位大自己四岁的婢女，全然没有主人的态度，而是平等相待。这反倒“惯坏”了她。
“别废话，快去。”楚天舒当即就变了语气，厉声呵斥道。

“哦。”青儿这才遵命，一路小跑，提来两大桶水，倒入浴盆中。
随后，手上赤焰燃起，四周热气翻滚。青儿将手掌伸入水中，轻轻滑动。只是顷刻，一盆冷水便被烧成了沸水。
没错，眼前这位婢女实力不凡，修为更是达到了灵泽七级。就修为而言，她已经超过了大部分同龄的楚家人。

content_en:
In the hall, the number of people gradually became sparse.
It is estimated that it won't take long for Chu Tianshu and Chu Yue's half-year appointment to spread throughout the Chu family.
"Tian Shu... you..." Chu Hong hesitated, "Oh——"
"You kid, you are too reckless! Half a year...half a year! What are you going to do against Chu Yue?" Du Xian raised her eyebrows in anger and grabbed Chu Tianshu's ears.
"Ouch! Mother! What are you doing?" Chu Tianshu quickly begged for mercy, "I'm really sure that in half a year... ah! Be gentle... Mother, please be gentle!"
"That's nonsense! A half-year appointment? Don't you think it's embarrassing enough?" Du Xian became angrier as she thought about it, "Don't think that just because you're smart, you can do whatever you want. In Canglan Continent, strength is the most important thing! No matter how smart you are, what's the use? Can you cultivate to the level of veins?"
"Even if I can't beat him, it's my face that I'll lose. It has nothing to do with you and dad." Chu Tianshu cried out bitterly, "Mom, it hurts! Let go..."
"Alas -" Du Xian seemed to understand his son's "plot". If he loses in half a year, he can take all the shame on himself.
"The matter has come to an end," Chu Hong said, "Tian Shu, can you bear the humiliation in half a year? Or...let Tian Qing play on your behalf?"
Chu Tianqing's face turned pale: "No, dad, you know, in just half a year, I have only been able to reach the fourth level of Lingze after working hard. How can I possibly compete with Chu Yue? Even if she suppresses her own cultivation with only one line of strength, I am no match."
"That's not necessarily the case!" Chu Hong said solemnly, "My Yunmai has a secret inheritance that may allow you to reach the strength to compete with her in half a year."
Hearing this, Du Xian put down his hand, and Chu Tianshu kneaded his bloodshot red ears, feeling a strange feeling in his heart.
"Secret inheritance?" Chu Tianqing asked doubtfully.
"That's right, that inheritance cannot be obtained by anyone without superior qualifications. It is a method passed down by an ancestor of our Chu family. As a father, I also relied on this method to quickly break through the veins." Chu Hong recalled.
"That's great. With this method, I will definitely be able to defeat that Chu Yue!" Chu Tianqing said expectantly.
"It's not that easy. After all, I have taught Chu Yue for four years. I have seen her talent. She is really talented and hard-working. She is still persisting even after the sword hilt rubbed her hands bloody." Du Xian didn't wait for Chu Tianqing to be happy for too long before pouring a basin of cold water on her.
"Indeed, that child is indeed outstanding and can be called the leader of the younger generation of the Chu family, but it's a pity that he joined Qingmai somehow? We treat her so well, shouldn't we be like this?" Chu Hong murmured to himself, and then his eyes were fixed on Chu Tianshu, "Did you do something excessive to Chu Yue? To make her resentful?"
"No!" Chu Tianshu took a few steps back and said, "Then you should busy passing on the inheritance first, and I will go to practice first."
In the blink of an eye, Chu Tianshu slipped away. The couple looked at each other and saw helplessness in each other's eyes.
After leaving the meeting hall, Chu Tianshu did not go home first, but went to the market to buy a large amount of medicinal materials and animal blood.
He returned to his dormitory at night.
Chu Tianshu took out a large number of spiritual plants that he purchased from his storage bag: Huoluoguo, Bluesilver Grass, Vine Root, Wuxian Zhi... a total of more than ten bags of herbal medicine.
"This body is quite good, with rich Qi and blood, and the physical quality is far better than that of people of the same age. So let's take the path of body training first." Chu Tianshu said to himself, "Body training... I don't have many choices."
Chu Tianshu recalled the skills he obtained in his previous life:
"The Fighting Saint Transformation Technique, which only attacks but not defends, is unparalleled in the world. It is the most powerful attack technique in modern times. In my previous life, I practiced it to great perfection and killed the opponent across seven small realms. But... this technique takes an extreme route and has no means of restoring defense. It is not conducive to long-term fighting. I have to find other techniques."
After some thought, Chu Tianshu decisively gave up on the "Fighting Saint Transformation Technique" and instead considered the self-created technique he majored in in his previous life: "Wuji True Demonic Technique! I learned it in my previous life."The masters of hundreds of schools of thought have created their own techniques based on the demonic body. They have almost no major shortcomings or flaws. Even the supreme secret technique of the temple, the Taixuan Holy Spirit Technique, is slightly inferior. But there are too few physical cultivation methods, and besides... the devil is a taboo in this world! "
In recent times, under his leadership, the Demonic Dao became the most powerful faction in the human race, but what has happened to them now that they have been suppressed? As far as Chu Tianshu knows, the demonic path is almost extinct by the righteous path in today's era, and it has declined terribly! How can it still have half the majesty of recent times?
Chu Tianshu guessed that the suppression of the Demonic Way was most likely related to him. After he passed away, the demonic dragons were leaderless and became a piece of loose sand. Split by division, internal fighting by internal fighting, the three righteous religions will definitely take this opportunity to return to the main sect of the human race. There are really many ups and downs.
This time Chu Tianshu was in trouble, because the remaining skills did not reach a level that satisfied him.
"Wait! I remembered it, and it seems that there is another technique that can satisfy me. "A flash of inspiration suddenly flashed in Chu Tianshu's mind, "The Human King Sutra! The supreme body-training technique in the Middle Ages originated from the lineage of the King of Humans who pioneered the human race's body-training method. It is known as the first body-training secret technique throughout the ages! In my previous life, I accidentally received the inheritance from the last human king. Although I practiced for some time, it conflicted with my demonic skills, so I had to give up. I had to start over again, just in time to practice! "
The "Human King Sutra", like the "Wuji True Demonic Art", has almost no shortcomings. If it were not for the "spiritual power explosion" in recent ancient times, the spiritual energy in the world would be unreasonably rich. The body refining method was not suitable for the environment of this world and was abandoned by most monks. The Human King lineage was declining day by day and was almost extinct. The last human king had to pass this method to the "Devil Lord" and other talented people. Otherwise, Chu Tianshu would not be able to practice this supreme skill in later generations.
“It’s just the King of Kings! Chu Tianshu took a deep breath and made up his mind: "Qing'er, get some water, and then put three small pieces of each of these medicinal materials into the basin." "
"Coming. "
Qing'er walked deftly into the room with strong curiosity in his eyes: "Master, what are these? "
“Medicinal materials for cultivation. "Chu Tianshu said.
"Medicine? Who is practicing in the training tub? Qing'er said, "Master, have you listened to some weird folk remedies and secrets?" "
"Okay, bring me some water quickly. "Chu Tianshu said impatiently.
"Single Spirit Vein...Single Spirit Vein...Young master is so smart, how could he have Sole Spirit Vein? Qing'er said regretfully, "It's true that I have only one spiritual vein. Isn't that a waste?" "
Due to time travel, Chu Tianshu's body is a soul from the 21st century. He has no master's attitude towards this maid who is four years older than him, but treats her as an equal. This actually "spoiled" her.
"Stop talking nonsense and go quickly. "Chu Tianshu immediately changed his tone and scolded sternly.
"Oh. Qing'er then obeyed the order, ran all the way, picked up two large buckets of water, and poured them into the bathtub.
Then, red flames ignited on his hands, and heat rolled around him. Qing'er put her palm into the water and slid it gently. In just a moment, a basin of cold water was turned into boiling water.
That's right, the maid in front of you has extraordinary strength, and her cultivation level has even reached the seventh level of Lingze. In terms of cultivation, she has surpassed most of the Chu family members of the same age.
